instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a modern cafe with a large beige arched partition, the woman in the beige blazer and blue bandana (R1) sits on the left, smiling broadly and gesturing with both hands spread wide. On the right, the woman in the pink corduroy blazer and glasses (R2) sits in a wheelchair, smiling back as she listens with her hands resting in her lap. They are seated opposite each other at a small black table with a coffee cup. Warm, natural daylight fills the space, casting soft shadows and enhancing the warm, friendly mood.
